open_points.subject: BootstrapAlreadyCompleted
open_points.text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise BootstrapAlreadyCompleted, and never the input rejection, when the port reports an already initialized store, so a repeat attempt changes nothing and the caller can tell a second run apart from a mistyped address. IdentityInputRejected stays reserved for the supplied email and password. A genuine storage failure MUST propagate unchanged and MUST NOT be turned into either refusal. BootstrapAlreadyCompleted is this module's own exception, defined here at top level as a plain Exception subclass whose body is pass and raised without arguments; it is not imported.
open_points.other_text:
OWNED CLASSES REQUIRED (must be defined locally, not merely referenced):
No owned local classes required.
open_points.question: Must BootstrapAlreadyCompleted be defined locally, or must the statement that no owned local classes are required change?
